description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a pale pink pillow is in front, with a small white two-drawer nightstand-sized box sitting near the center-right. The right hand moves in toward the box, grips the top drawer knob, and pulls straight outward to slide the drawer open while the left hand reaches forward to steady the top edge of the box; then the right hand continues pulling until the drawer fully comes out and is set down on the bed in front, leaving the box behind with the bottom drawer still in place.
